card.name: Opioid monitoring for development of behaviors
card.fires_on: The words "for" and "of" in the opioid addiction-risk warning, in the phrase "monitor all patients receiving [drug] for the development of these behaviors and conditions".

modes.label: "for" after drug name
modes.description: The word "for" right after the drug name or "regularly" in the monitoring sentence.
modes.example: and monitor all patients receiving Oxycodone Hydrochloride Oral Solution<< for>> the development of these behaviors and conditions.

modes.label: "of" after development
modes.description: The word "of" in "the development of these behaviors".
modes.example: and reassess all patients receiving Oxycodone and Acetaminophen Tablets for the development<< of>> these behaviors and conditions. Risks are
